event: Scraping eggs from a frying pan with a spatula.

sounding_object.description: A black, circular, metallic frying pan, approximately 25-30 cm in diameter, with a long black handle. A black plastic/nylon spatula is used to scrape the eggs from the pan. The sound is generated by the spatula scraping against the surface of the pan.

reference_object.description: The camera is worn by the person, representing their point of view.

question: Imagine you are the camera wearer, when the scraping sound comes up, relative to where you are standing, what is the distance between you and the sound source in meters? Consider the center point location of the object as the its location. Answer in numeric format.
